turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you, and that makes total sense. When you’ve had bad experiences before, it’s worth being picky.

A quick bit of context so you know what you’re getting with us:

All of our roses are grown on their own roots at our nurseries in Oregon (we don’t resell from other growers).
They are true to variety and virus-free, and shipped in 1-gallon containers with soil, not as bare root plants.
We defoliate before shipping so they arrive healthy and ready to grow, not stressed and leafless by accident.
